title: Oppendorf Lancaster Memorial
memorial_details: Memorial stone and plaque on the village green, Oppendorf (Stemwede), Nordrhein-Westfalen.
narrative: Lancaster LM424 of 625 Squadron, coded CF-B, departed Kelstern at 1621 on 16 December 1943 for Berlin. The aircraft was intercepted near Quakenbrück by Major Helmut Lent, Stab NJG3, and shot down at 1907 — his 79th claim. The aircraft crashed into the village centre of Oppendorf. Six crew were killed; one survived as a prisoner of war. Two civilians on the ground were also killed.
cause_of_loss: Shot down by night fighter — Maj Helmut Lent (Stab NJG3), his 79th claim; crashed into village centre
community_connection: The aircraft crashed into the village centre of Oppendorf, killing two civilians.
